description: Golden retrieval set: real recall questions with the memory surface each must find. Run by scripts/test-recall-golden.sh. Every expectation is a confirmed fact that lives in the named source. Add cases when a recall miss is discovered; never invent facts.
threshold_note: Two-tier gate (2026-07-20): floor_threshold is the HARD line - below it the index is treated as broken (job fails, cron notifies). pass_threshold is the aspirational TARGET - between floor and target the run is a healthy WARN (exit 0, no false failure). This exists because a genuinely healthy 90% index was reporting FAILURE against a 95% hard gate, training the operator to ignore the job status. The two standing near-misses (MYOB rotation, orphaned-worktree archiving) are real facts that live in their expected sources but sit just outside top-3 because higher-authority topically-adjacent lessons legitimately out-rank them; chasing 100% by retuning fusion would risk the 18 passing cases.
